description: This file is a Perl module script for setting a new password for a user in the Coocook application. It defines a class with methods to interactively prompt for a new password, verify it, and update the user record in the database.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Passwd
classes.description: A class for handling password change scripts, including prompting for new passwords and updating user records.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to execute the password change process: prompts for new password, verifies, and updates the user record.

methods.name: readline
methods.description: Reads a line of input from the user with the specified prompt, handling terminal modes for password input.
